blockers.quote: Another year, for that chair. Keep going?
blockers.why: story #3. At about 115 words a minute this second hook ends near 0:40. At 0:30 I am still hearing line 33, so I know the chip rule and cannot yet say that I can lose the year, or that the question is whether I keep going.
blockers.fix: Move this line to immediately after line 31, before "It starts at the crowd's number. Then it moves with what you do." Same words in that slot: Another year, for that chair. Keep going? Spoken there, it ends near 0:28.

blockers.why: story #11. The six-second crane just showed a chip in every window. The line says the shot and adds nothing.
blockers.fix: You hunt the brightest. Same as the hall.

blockers.quote: The chaiwala, sixty-one, painting a new board at midnight.
blockers.why: story #11. I can see him painting the board, and I already know sixty-one. Nothing new happens to me.
blockers.fix: Sixty-one. He didn't shop for it either.

blockers.quote: The topper, eight, at her keyboard, headphones on.
blockers.why: story #11. This is where I stop watching. Headphones and the keyboard are the whole shot, and it is the second window in a row that does nothing new to me.

blockers.quote: The teacher, three, marking your mock, then opening his own notes.
blockers.why: story #11. The red pen and his own notes are already the shot. The line narrates them.
blockers.fix: Three. He didn't shop for it. He sat his own.

blockers.quote: And right below you, one window with no light in it.
blockers.why: story #11. The tilt already found the one dark window, and the next four seconds hold on that same picture. The line describes it.

suggestions.quote: Ninety-one was never a verdict. It was the crowd's starting point, waiting to see what you'd do.
suggestions.fix: Cut this line. I am still on the bus and the story is standing still: line 183 already said the ninety-one was the crowd watching me copy. Go straight to the drawer.

suggestions.quote: So here's the honest part. It's still tiny. So is yours. The chips never lied.
suggestions.fix: It's still tiny. So is yours. The chips never lied.

keep.quote: Four hundred of you are asking directions from a man who's still looking for the place.
The biggest number tells you what is likely. It cannot tell you what is worth choosing.
He can't see it. He never could. He was fine until you read it to him.
